Ui.EntryPicker.Hint.en: Double-click an entry to select it

Ui.JsonViewer.Hint.zh: Ctrl+F 搜索 · 点 /lol-game-data/ 路径跳到该资源
Ui.JsonViewer.Hint.en: Ctrl+F to search · click a /lol-game-data/ path to jump to that asset

Ui.JsonViewer.ModeHint.zh: 在格式化后的 JSON 和客户端原始文本之间切换
Ui.JsonViewer.ModeHint.en: Switch between formatted JSON and the client's raw text

Ui.Main.About.Hint.zh: 项目声明与素材版权说明

Ui.Main.Audio.DownloadSpeechModel.zh: 下载语音识别模型（约 141 MB，只需一次）
Ui.Main.Audio.DownloadSpeechModel.en: Download the speech model (about 141 MB, one time only)

Ui.Main.Audio.NoteLabel.zh: 备注（自动保存，可手工修改）

Ui.Main.Audio.NotePlaceholder.zh: 这里显示转写结果，也可自己输入
Ui.Main.Audio.NotePlaceholder.en: The transcription lands here; you can also type your own

Ui.Main.Audio.TranscribeAllHint.zh: 把这个音频包里的每条流都转成文字
Ui.Main.Audio.TranscribeAllHint.en: Transcribes every stream in this audio pack

Ui.Main.Audio.TranscribeHint.zh: 把选中的音频转成文字写进备注
Ui.Main.Audio.TranscribeHint.en: Transcribes the selected audio into its note

Ui.Main.BrowseMode.Hint.zh: 按 wad：一次看一个 wad 的目录；按分类：全部 wad 按 英雄 / 皮肤 / 装备 等归好类
Ui.Main.BrowseMode.Hint.en: By wad: one wad at a time; by category: every wad sorted into champions, skins, items and so on

Ui.Main.Catalog.AssignHint.zh: 把选中节点下的全部文件归到这个组（写入 catalog-overrides.json）
Ui.Main.Catalog.AssignHint.en: Moves every file under the selected node into this group (written to catalog-overrides.json)

Ui.Main.Catalog.AssignPlaceholder.zh: 归属到组：英雄别名或组名
Ui.Main.Catalog.AssignPlaceholder.en: Move to group: champion alias or group name

Ui.Main.Catalog.RebuildHint.zh: 重新扫描并分类（改了手写规则后会自动重建）
Ui.Main.Catalog.RebuildHint.en: Rescan and reclassify (editing the hand-written rules rebuilds automatically)

Ui.Main.Catalog.SearchPlaceholder.zh: 搜索全部 wad 的路径，例如 ahri 或 .bnk
Ui.Main.Catalog.SearchPlaceholder.en: Search paths across every wad, e.g. ahri or .bnk

Ui.Main.DataRoot.Hint.zh: 填安装根目录会把 LeagueClient\plugins 下的客户端包一起列出；填 Game\DATA 只扫游戏包
Ui.Main.DataRoot.Hint.en: The install root also lists the client packages under LeagueClient\plugins; Game\DATA scans the game packages only

Ui.Main.Export.Categories.zh: 导出类别（全选表示不过滤）
Ui.Main.Export.Categories.en: Export categories (all ticked means no filter)

Ui.Main.Export.CurrentHint.zh: 导出预览中的这个条目；音频包只导出音频列表里选中的那一条流
Ui.Main.Export.CurrentHint.en: Exports the entry shown in the preview; for an audio pack only the stream selected in the list is exported

Ui.Main.Export.ExtensionsHint.zh: 留空表示全部。例如 skn,skl,tex
Ui.Main.Export.ExtensionsHint.en: Empty means all. For example skn,skl,tex

Ui.Main.Export.OptionConvertTexturesHint.zh: 关闭后纹理按 wad 里的原始格式导出（.tex / .dds）
Ui.Main.Export.OptionConvertTexturesHint.en: When off, textures keep the format they have in the wad (.tex / .dds)

Ui.Main.Export.OptionFlatHint.zh: 不保留资源目录结构，全部放到导出目录下
Ui.Main.Export.OptionFlatHint.en: Drops the asset folder structure and puts every file in the output folder

Ui.Main.Export.OptionGroupByWad.zh: 按 wad 建立子目录

Ui.Main.Export.OptionGroupByWadHint.zh: 每个 wad 的文件导出到以 wad 命名的子目录
Ui.Main.Export.OptionGroupByWadHint.en: Each wad's files go into a subfolder named after the wad

Ui.Main.Export.OptionIncludeUnnamedHint.zh: 未命名的条目以哈希命名导出
Ui.Main.Export.OptionIncludeUnnamedHint.en: Unnamed entries are exported under their hash

Ui.Main.Export.OptionSkipExistingHint.zh: 跳过已经导出过的文件
Ui.Main.Export.OptionSkipExistingHint.en: Skips files that were already exported

Ui.Main.Export.PatternHint.zh: 留空表示全部。例如 *skins/base/* 或 *.bnk
Ui.Main.Export.PatternHint.en: Empty means all. For example *skins/base/* or *.bnk

Ui.Main.Export.PrefixLabel.zh: 目录前缀（只导出该目录下的文件，留空表示全部）
Ui.Main.Export.PrefixLabel.en: Folder prefix (only files under it are exported; empty means all)

Ui.Main.Export.StartHint.zh: 按当前设置导出所选 wad 的条目
Ui.Main.Export.StartHint.en: Exports the entries of the selected wads with these settings

Ui.Main.Menu.ExportCatalogNode.zh: 导出这个节点（按分类落盘）
Ui.Main.Menu.ExportCatalogNode.en: Export this node (sorted into category folders)

Ui.Main.Menu.UseAsPrefix.zh: 把此目录设为导出前缀
Ui.Main.Menu.UseAsPrefix.en: Use this folder as the export prefix

Ui.Main.Tree.SearchPlaceholder.zh: 按路径或哈希搜索，例如 skins/base 或 .bnk
Ui.Main.Tree.SearchPlaceholder.en: Search by path or hash, e.g. skins/base or .bnk

Ui.Main.Wads.ClearHint.zh: 取消列表里当前显示的 wad 的勾选（搜索时只作用在结果上）
Ui.Main.Wads.ClearHint.en: Clears the ticks of the wads shown in the list (only the search results while searching)

Ui.Main.Wads.SearchPlaceholder.zh: 搜索 wad 名称或路径

Ui.Main.Wads.SelectAllHint.zh: 勾选列表里当前显示的 wad（搜索时只作用在结果上）；全部勾选后按钮变为「全不选」
Ui.Main.Wads.SelectAllHint.en: Ticks the wads shown in the list (only the search results while searching); once all are ticked the button reads "Select none"

Ui.ModelPreview.Hint.zh: 左键拖拽旋转 · 右键拖拽平移 · 滚轮缩放
Ui.ModelPreview.Hint.en: Left-drag to rotate · right-drag to pan · scroll to zoom
